rules.name: DRENCH THE LANDSCAPE
rules.text: Spirit Actions and Special Rules treat your [Sacred Site] as Wetlands in addition to the printed terrain.
rules.turn:
sacred-site S L, spirit:special S drench / terrain-for power L wetland
sacred-site S L, spirit:special S drench / terrain-for special-rule L wetland
rules.evidence: wetland-only range-0 cards: can-target rain l3, can-target flood l3 (mountain Sacred Site); at the same moment l3 is wetland only for contexts power and special-rule, not invader/blight.
rules.notes: Direct use of core's terrain-for <context> view. 'Special Rules' has no consumers in core (no other spirit's special rule reads terrain-for special-rule), so that half is declared but untested.

rules.name: POUR DOWN POWER ACROSS THE ISLAND
rules.text: For each 2 [Water] you have, during the [Fasticon] / [Slowicon] phase you may either: Gain 1 Energy; or Repeat a land-targeting Power Card by paying its cost again. (It need not target the same land.) Use scenario markers or spare game pieces to track uses of this rule. (Max 5 times per turn, no matter how much [Water] you have.)
rules.turn:
#acc pour-used : spirit @sum
spirit:special S pour / pour-used S 0
poured S O / pour-used S 1
fast-phase, spirit:special S pour, ~pour S fast
slow-phase, spirit:special S pour, ~pour S slow
#acc pour-option : spirit e e
pour S Ph / pour-option S Ph energy
pour S Ph / pour-option S Ph decline
pour S Ph, played S P, speed P Ph, power:target-terrain P _, power:cost P C
  energy S E, ge E C / pour-option S Ph (repeat P)
pour S Ph, elements S water W, pour-limit W Lim, pour-used S U, lt U Lim
  ?[rng] O
  !(pour-option S Ph O)
  ~pour-choice S Ph O
pour-choice S Ph C, is C energy, +poured S energy
pour-choice S Ph C, is C (repeat P), +poured S (repeat P)
pour-choice S Ph C, is C energy, +gain-energy S 1
pour-choice S Ph C, is C (repeat P), power:cost P Cost, neg Cost NC
  +gain-energy S NC
  ~use-power S P
fast-phase, >pour-choice S fast C, is C energy, ~pour S fast
fast-phase, >pour-choice S fast C, is C (repeat P), ~pour S fast
slow-phase, >pour-choice S slow C, is C energy, ~pour S slow
slow-phase, >pour-choice S slow C, is C (repeat P), ~pour S slow
rules.evidence: 4 Water -> exactly 2 pour-choice per turn; seed 2: repeat rain (gain-energy -1, use-power rain again) + gain 1 Energy; slow phase gets none (budget shared); seed 7: Energy twice.
rules.notes: Same loop shape as Swiftness of Lightning (budget acc recounted each use, `phase, >choice` to continue). 'Repeat' is simply another use-power episode. Needed 8 rules for one rule because each option x phase continuation is a separate rule. Port to fresh-left `^` (v2-caret-fresh-left): a use is now marked with `+poured` inside its choice; the old `turn, >pour-choice …, ^poured` started at a moment concurrent with the next offer, so the budget no longer counted earlier uses (4 uses instead of 2). `+` lasts past the turn, which is fine for the one-turn scenario but would need a turn key in a multi-turn game.

base_ext: Energy @sum; Range/targeting with target-terrain read through terrain-for power.
language_issues: Per-phase loops ('during the Fast/Slow phase, repeatedly') need one continuation rule per phase and per non-decline option; a generic 'repeat until decline within the enclosing phase' form would collapse 4 rules to 1.
Two copies of the same fact (two Water icons on one card) can't be written as duplicate facts reliably; used one Water per card.
